data.name: A Game About Getting Bigger
data.detailed_description:
A Game About Getting Bigger is a loot-driven incremental game about feeding a growing black hole. Destroy asteroids, planets, and other celestial bodies to make the black hole at the center grow larger and larger.

Each run is short and time-limited. Your goal is to destroy as many nearby objects as possible before time runs out. The shattered remains are pulled into the black hole, increasing its mass and pushing it closer to the scale of the legendary black holes that exist in the real universe.

At the end of every run, you’ll earn Beacons. Open them to collect Gems of different rarities, then equip them into matching slots to enhance your build and strengthen future runs.

Just... getting bigger.
